description: iShares Core S&P Small-Cap ETF tracks the S&P SmallCap 600 Index, which screens for financial viability (requiring positive earnings) unlike some broader small-cap benchmarks, resulting in a higher-quality small-cap exposure. Historically, smaller companies have delivered higher long-run returns than large-caps (the 'size premium'), at the cost of greater volatility. IJR is one of the largest and most liquid small-cap ETFs available, with a dividend yield around 1.4%.
